hero.subtitle: Cashew Processing
hero.title: From Raw Nuts to Premium Kernels
hero.description: AfriNuts processes cashews in two scalable phases, starting from small-batch, semi-automated systems and advancing to a modern, large-scale operation that ensures efficiency, quality, and sustainability. Using clean and sustainable techniques instead of chemicals or outdated methods, we deliver premium kernels ready for global markets.

roadmap.title: Processing Roadmap
roadmap.description: Our journey is structured in clear milestones, ensuring sustainable growth and efficiency.

phase1.title: Phase 1: Pilot / Semi-Automated
phase1.description: Focused on artisanal and semi-automatic methods with 1,000–2,000 MT/year.
phase1.point2: Train staff and build initial export capacity

phase2.title: Phase 2: Industrial / Automated
phase2.description: Scaling to 5,000 MT/year with advanced automation and global certifications.

phases.title: Our Processing Phases
phases.description: We've designed a scalable approach to cashew processing, starting with a pilot facility and expanding to industrial capacity.

phase1.title: Pilot Processing (2028-2030)
phase1.description: Our initial small-scale facility focuses on quality control, operational learning, and establishing market linkages with manual to semi-automated technology.

reception.title: Reception & Storage
reception.description: Raw cashew nuts are received, weighed, and stored in ventilated warehouses with proper moisture control and sampling for quality assessment.

steaming.title: Steaming & Roasting
steaming.description: Small-batch steam roasting softens shells without chemicals, preserving organic integrity and ensuring food safety standards.

shelling.title: Shelling
shelling.description: Manual and semi-automatic shelling with protective gear to handle cashew nut shell liquid safely while creating local employment opportunities.

drying.title: Drying & Peeling
drying.description: Kernels are carefully dried to optimal moisture levels and manually peeled to maintain quality and texture.

grading.title: Grading
grading.description: Visual inspection and manual sorting by size, color, and quality to meet international standards.

packaging.title: Packaging
packaging.description: Vacuum sealing with nitrogen flushing in export-ready packaging to preserve freshness and extend shelf life.

phase2.title: Industrial Scaling (2033+)
phase2.description: Our expanded facility will feature semi-automated processing lines with advanced quality control systems for higher volume production and full certification compliance.

reception.title: Automated Reception
reception.description: Advanced intake systems with automated weighing, sampling, and silo storage with climate control for optimal raw nut preservation.

steaming.title: Industrial Roasting
steaming.description: Continuous steam roasters with precise temperature control and biomass energy utilization for efficient, chemical-free processing.

shelling.title: Mechanical Shelling
shelling.description: Semi-automated shelling lines with dust extraction systems for improved efficiency and worker safety.

drying.title: Automated Drying
drying.description: Industrial dryers with digital moisture sensors and mechanical peeling aids for consistent quality and higher throughput.

grading.title: Electronic Grading
grading.description: Optical sorters, vibration graders, and metal detection systems for precise quality control and certification compliance.

packaging.title: Automated Packaging
packaging.description: High-speed vacuum packaging with nitrogen flushing, checkweighers, and automated labeling for export markets.

sustainability.title: Sustainability Practices
sustainability.description: We design every stage of our processing to reduce waste, conserve resources, and use renewable energy.

water.title: Water Efficiency

waste.title: Waste Management

whyProcessLocal.title: Why We Process Cashews in Ivory Coast
benefits: Keep value in the country of origin

cnslRecovery.title: CNSL Recovery & Reuse
cnslRecovery.description: The liquid from cashew shells (CNSL) is recovered during processing and used for biofuels, industrial lubricants, and polymer production. This creates an additional revenue stream and reduces waste.

midCta.title: See the Facility Behind the Process
midCta.description: Explore the layout of our future processing center — from raw nut intake to dispatch. Every zone designed for efficiency and certification compliance.

cnsl.title: CNSL: Turning Shell Waste Into Industrial Gold
cnsl.description: Cashew Nut Shell Liquid is a high-value byproduct extracted during processing. Instead of paying to dispose of shells, we sell CNSL to industries worldwide — transforming a cost into a profit center.

shellRecovery.title: 1. Shell Recovery
shellRecovery.description: During shelling, cashew shells are collected. 1 ton of raw nuts yields ~250kg of shells — all captured for processing.

extraction.title: 2. CNSL Extraction
extraction.description: Shells are pressed or solvent-extracted to yield CNSL — rich in cardanol and anacardic acid, prized industrial compounds.

revenue.title: 4. Revenue Impact
revenue.description: At full capacity, CNSL is projected to contribute 8-12% of total processing revenue — transforming a disposal cost into a profit center while achieving near-zero waste.

chemicalFree.title: 100% Chemical-Free Processing
chemicalFree.description: Unlike traditional methods that use chemicals to soften shells, our steaming process preserves organic integrity and ensures food safety.

traditional.title: Traditional Method
traditional.description: Many processors soak cashew shells in chemicals (like sodium hydroxide or hydrochloric acid) to soften them for cutting. This leaves chemical residues, damages kernels, and creates hazardous waste.

afrinuts.title: The AfriNuts Method
afrinuts.description: We use steam roasting to naturally soften cashew shells. No chemicals — just heat and pressure. Cleaner kernels, safer workers, zero chemical waste.
afrinuts.point4: Safer working conditions for our team

bottomLine.title: Why It Matters for Buyers
bottomLine.description: Chemical-free processing means our kernels meet the strictest EU organic import standards. For you, that means fewer rejected shipments, cleaner labels, and a product consumers trust.
